description: This is a C source file implementing relocatable package support, including functions for setting and computing installation prefixes, handling shared library paths, and relocating file paths based on installation directories.

methods.name: set_this_relocation_prefix
methods.description: Sets the original and current installation prefix strings used for path relocation.

methods.name: set_relocation_prefix
methods.description: Sets the installation prefix for relocation and notifies dependent libraries.

methods.name: compute_curr_prefix
methods.description: Computes the current installation prefix based on original prefix, original directory, and current path.

methods.name: relocate
methods.description: Relocates a given pathname according to the current installation prefix.
